items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 05 August 2026 at 12:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Slow moving area of low pressure over Scotland as various frontal zones affect the British Isles.


##Wind##

West or west-southwest, veering west or west-northwest late this afternoon, 5 or 6, occasionally increasing 7 mainly in the east of the area until around midnight. Then decreasing 4 or 5 tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, occasionally locally rough. Then becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Rain or showers, becoming mainly fair later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or west-northwest 4 or 5, backing mainly west or southwest 3 or 4 in the afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, soon becoming slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mainly good.
